newsitem.title: USA: Ampal-American says to post Q2 gain.
newsitem.headline: Ampal-American says to post Q2 gain.

text.p: Ampal-American Israel Corp said on Tuesday that it expects to record second quarter income of about $7 million.

"Ampal will record income in the second quarter in the amount of approximately $7 million ($4.6 million net of taxes.) The after-tax income amounts to $0.17 per share of Ampal Class A stock," Ampal said in a statement.

Ampal attributed the earnings projection to the sale of 860,000 shares of Teledata Communications Ltd by Ampal affiliate, Ophir Holdings Ltd. The shares were part of a Teledata public offering, Ampal said.
Ampal has a 42.5 percent stake in Ophir.
The total offering by Teledata consisted of 2,760,000 shares offered at $26 per share, including 1,100,000 shares offered by Teledata and 1,660,000 shares offered by selling shareholders, Ampal said.
